changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Create table for compact (codbi-core-elements-compact / codbi-core-api-compact) AI prompts

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Add pre_prompt_active and post_prompt_active columns to allow disabling pre/post prompts independently while keeping the main prompt active.

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Add is_system flag to distinguish built-in system prompts from user-created prompts. Built-in prompts are seeded from classpath resources; user prompts are created via the Prompt Manager UI. Only user-created prompts can be renamed or deleted.

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Widen prompt_key from VARCHAR(100) to VARCHAR(200) on SQL Server. SQL Server (error 5074) does not allow ALTER COLUMN on a key column, so the primary key is temporarily dropped. Dropping the PK also removes the implicit NOT NULL of the key column, so NOT NULL is explicitly re-applied (error 8111). The SQL is idempotent and also heals an interrupted earlier migration where the PK was already dropped and/or the column already widened.

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Widen prompt_key from VARCHAR(100) to VARCHAR(200) on databases that allow ALTER COLUMN on a key column (all except SQL Server).

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Add update_available flag to indicate that a newer version of a system prompt exists in the bundled .md resources while the local copy was customized by the user. The Prompt Manager uses this to show a hint that offers to load the new version via "Restore Original".
